title: Resolution to update groups getting Council discretionary funding
summary: This resolution approves new organizations and changes to previously named organizations receiving discretionary funding under the City's Fiscal 2025, 2026 and 2027 expense budgets. It covers numerous Council initiatives, including youth, aging, anti-poverty, arts and community programs, as listed in attached charts. Some listed organizations have not yet completed required prequalification review, and funding for others depends on a future budget modification.
